title: Stock Analysts’ Price Target Changes for March, 28th (AAPL, ABBN, AKG, BB, CNE, DRG.UN, EDV, GSS, GUY, KL)
text:
Posted by ABMN Staff on Mar 28th, 2018 // No Comments 
Stock Analysts’ price target changes for Wednesday, March 28th: 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) was given a $203.00 price target by analysts at Royal Bank of Canada. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock. Get Apple alerts: 
ABB (VTX:ABBN) was given a CHF 23 target price by analysts at JPMorgan Chase & Co.. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock. Asanko Gold (TSE:AKG) (NYSEMKT:AKG) had its target price raised by BMO Capital Markets from C$0.70 to C$1.25. 
BlackBerry (TSE:BB) (NASDAQ:BBRY) was given a C$12.00 target price by analysts at BMO Capital Markets. The firm currently has a market perform rating on the stock.
